basics.name: Abdullah Hilson
basics.label: Full-Stack Engineer
basics.summary: Experienced Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years in web and mobile development, specializing in React, TypeScript, and backend frameworks like Node.js and Django. Proven ability to lead teams, ship scalable SaaS products, and improve engineering workflows under tight deadlines.

work.name: btr.tech
work.summary: Led the frontend and mobile development for three core SAAS products in logistics and e-commerce: 'Shopraha' (automated grocery), 'Rover' (delivery fleet management), and 'Halo' (warehouse management). Drove the architectural vision for mobile applications and co-led the successful implementation of a Turborepo monorepo to unify development across all dashboards.
highlights: Managed a mobile team of 4 in developing a React Native e-commerce app, establishing the foundational architecture and deployment pipelines.
Mentored a team of 5 developers, conducted rigorous code reviews, and implemented SCRUM methodologies to boost team performance and product quality.

Co-led the Turborepo monorepo initiative, delivering a shared Ant Design component library used by four product dashboards, eliminating ~45% of duplicated UI code in listing pages and accelerating feature delivery.
Improved monorepo dashboards build time by over 70% by migrating from Next.js to Vite and adopting Bun as the package manager, drastically accelerating CI and local feedback loops.
Led the full lifecycle development of two complex mobile applications for logistics and warehouse management using Capacitor and Tailwind CSS.
Established and enforced a robust testing culture, implementing full E2E test suites with Playwright and comprehensive integration tests for critical mobile applications.
Spearheaded development of 'Rover', a complete fleet management solution, delivering the driver's mobile app and contributing significantly to the admin dashboard.
Actively partnered with the product manager to streamline features to enhance maintainability, and prioritize high-impact work to accelerate delivery.

work.name: Andela
work.description: Building the tech team of the future
work.summary: Contributed as a senior engineer within a global talent network, developing robust dashboards with React and TypeScript, and building serverless APIs using Python and AWS CDK. Focused on delivering high-quality, tested code for various client projects.
highlights: Developed dashboards using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL. Wrote unit tests and integration tests with testing library
Designed and built serverless APIs using Python, AWS Lambda, and CDK with full test coverage
Analyzed requirements and provided expert solutions; offered valuable advice to leaders and designers.

work.name: Kenz'up
work.description: Your multi-brand application for loyalty and payments
work.summary: As a key mobile engineer, I led a React Native application to its production launch. My role involved resolving critical bugs across the full stack (mobile and Django backend), integrating new features and designs, and mentoring junior developers to enhance team capabilities.
highlights: Led the React Native app to a successful production launch, achieving over 5 million downloads and a 4.5-star rating from 35.1k reviews while resolving critical bugs across the full stack.
Integrated complex features and new designs in the mobile app.
Mentored and advised 2 junior developers, enhancing team capabilities.
Developed an internal tool with Express.js

work.name: Obytes
work.description: A team of passionate developers, designers, and product managers creating responsive web and mobile applications for startups and agencies.
work.summary: Transitioned to a full-stack role, taking ownership of backend development with Python and Django while continuing frontend work. Key contributions include implementing a full-featured subscription and payment system and improving overall backend code quality through refactoring and best practices.
highlights: Focused on backend development using Python, Django framework, and GraphQL, including unit tests and integration tests
Continued work on the frontend with React.js
Implemented a subscription system with recurring payments using PayPal, TAP, and wire payments (backend/frontend)
Enhanced backend code quality through refactoring and best practices
Conducted code reviews and offered guidance to a team of 9 developers.

work.name: Obytes
work.description: A team of passionate developers, designers, and product managers creating responsive web and mobile applications for startups and agencies.
work.summary: As a frontend specialist, I built and optimized responsive user interfaces using React, Redux, and Gatsby.js. My work involved integrating complex features like social logins and video players, significantly improving application performance and user engagement.
highlights: Built interfaces with React.js, Redux, and Apollo Client
Boosted user experience by cutting load time by 80% through a strategic migration to Gatsby.js.
Integrated social login and registration, video players, code editors, and logic for code challenges and quizzes
Contributed to a learning platform that scaled to 400,000 users, managing 650,000 learning path completions and 5,000 project submissions.
Mentored 3 frontend team members and newcomers.

work.name: Devpal Solutions
work.summary: Founded a web and mobile development consultancy. As CTO, I led the technical strategy for various client projects on a part-time basis, delivering solutions using React, backend frameworks (Rails, Node.js, Django), and mobile stacks like React Native.
highlights: Website development with WordPress
Frontend app development using React, GatsbyJS, and Next.js
Backend app development with Ruby on Rails, Node.js, and Django
Creation of mobile apps using React Native and Ionic
